    StartersBuddy Holly chickenYour waiter brings it to the carHow to make it600g chicken tenderloins250ml buttermilk1 tsp hot sauce150g plain flour2 tsp sweet paprika1 tsp garlic powder1 tsp salt1 L vegetable oil3 tbsp honey3 tbsp yellow mustard2 tbsp mayonnaise1 lemonSoak the chicken in the buttermilk and hot sauce for at least 30 minutes in the fridge.Mix the flour, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Lift the chicken out, let it drip, then press it into the flour so it gets a shaggy coat.Fry in oil at 175°C in batches for 4 to 5 minutes until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack and salt again.Stir the honey, mustard and mayonnaise together for dipping.Pile the chicken into paper-lined baskets with the dip and lemon wedges.Mamie's devilled eggsPaprika, crisp shallots, chivesHow to make it8 eggs80g mayonnaise2 tsp Dijon mustard1 tsp white vinegar1 tsp hot sauce2 shallots60ml vegetable oil1 tsp smoked paprika1 bunch chivesLower the eggs into boiling water for 10 minutes, then straight into iced water.Slice the shallots thin and fry them slowly in the oil until golden and crisp. Drain on paper.Peel and halve the eggs. Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar and hot sauce until smooth, and season.Pipe or spoon the yolk back into the whites.Dust with smoked paprika and top with crisp shallots and snipped chives.Slim's friesHolland mayo. Paris has Royale with CheeseHow to make it1kg russet potatoes1 L vegetable oil, for deep frying1 tsp salttomato sauce, to servemayonnaise, to serveCut the potatoes into thin fries.Soak in cold water for an hour (included in cook time), then dry well.Fry in oil at 140°C for 5 minutes in batches.Rest the fries on a rack until cool.Fry again at 190°C until crisp, salt and serve in red-checked paper boats with tomato sauce and a pot of mayonnaise, the way they do it in Holland.MainsDouglas Sirk steakVincent's order. Cooked rareHow to make it4 sirloin steakssalt, to taste800g frozen skin-on fries1 tbsp vegetable oil1 shallot, finely chopped1 tbsp black peppercorns, crushed30ml brandy150ml cream1 iceberg lettuce120g blue cheese80g sour creamSeason the sirloin steaks with salt an hour ahead and leave them out of the fridge.Bake the frozen skin-on fries at 220°C for 25 minutes until crisp.Heat the oil in a pan until smoking and sear the steaks for 2 minutes a side until 48°C inside, then rest them for 5 minutes.In the same pan cook the shallot and crushed peppercorns for 1 minute, add the brandy and cream and simmer for 2 minutes.Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges and spoon over the blue cheese mashed with the sour cream.
